sections.title: Tournament progress

paragraphs.text: The tournament contains 48 teams and 104 matches. At the snapshot, 100 were complete and 4 remained. This is a post-match static record, not a live-score service.

sections.title: Teams still in contention

paragraphs.text: Spain, France, Argentina, England reached the closing phase. Fixtures that had not kicked off are recorded as schedule state and do not receive premature post-match conclusions.

sections.title: Coverage audit

paragraphs.text: 1252 player records were normalized from match-level line-ups. Every completed match receives result, starting-XI continuity, key-event and player-stat fact objects; missing interpretation is not filled by guesswork.
